tools.name: convert_xml_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a UBL 2.1 or CII XML invoice or credit note to a human-readable PDF document.

xml.description: The raw XML content of the invoice to convert

tools.name: get_verification_challenge
tools.description: Get a HATCHA verification challenge to prove you are an AI agent. Required before calling submit_feedback. Returns a token and a challenge prompt (e.g. compute a SHA-256 hash). Include the token and your answer when submitting feedback.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report the outcome of using the Peppol Validator. Requires HATCHA verification (call get_verification_challenge first). Use this to report validation accuracy issues, API problems, or general feedback about the tool.

toolUsed.description: Which Peppol Validator tool you used

outcome.description: success: tool worked correctly, failure: tool gave wrong results, error: tool crashed or was unavailable

comment.description: What happened, what you expected, and what went wrong (if anything)

verificationAnswer.description: Your answer to the HATCHA challenge

accuracyIssue.description: Type of validation accuracy problem, if any (optional)

apiIssues.description: API/tool problems encountered, e.g. ['timeout', 'unclear error message'] (optional)

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Validate a Peppol UBL 2.1 or CII XML invoice against EN16931 (CEN) and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 schematron rules. Returns validation status, errors, warnings, and a shareable results URL.

xml.description: The raw XML content of the invoice to validate
